name: Related Skills
headline: Encore Frontend: Type-Safe API Integration
short_description: Encore provides tools to integrate your frontend applications seamlessly with backend APIs. It generates a fully typed TypeScript client based on your API definitions for easy usage.
author: encoredev

sections.overview:
The encore-frontend skill helps developers connect React and Next.js applications to Encore backend APIs. It generates fully-typed TypeScript clients automatically based on your API definitions, eliminating manual client code and type mismatches. This skill is essential for frontend developers building against Encore backends, ensuring type safety across the entire API boundary and reducing integration errors. By leveraging Encore's declarative infrastructure and type-safe APIs, frontends can trust that their API calls are validated at compile time.
Generate a TypeScript client for local development.
Generate a TypeScript client for a deployed environment.
Connect frontend applications to backend services.
